paite: Huan, Toupa Pathianin gam sa a bawl tengteng lakah gul a gitlouhpil pen hi, Huchiin, aman numei kiangah, Pathianin, Huana sing gah himhim na ne ding uh ahi kei, chi ahi maw? a chi a.
english: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which Yahweh God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden?’”

paite: Huan, numeiin gul kiangah chilou e, huana sing gahte nethei mah ung:
english: The woman said to the serpent, “Of the fruit of the trees of the garden we may eat,

paite: Huan laizanga sing gah bel Pathianin, Na ne ding uh ahi kei, khoih leng na khoih ding uh ahi kei, huchilouinjaw na si ding uh chi aka, a chi a.
english: but of the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden, God has said, ‘You shall not eat of it, neither shall you touch it, lest you die.’”

paite: Huan, gulin, numei kiangah, Si zenzen lou e:
english: The serpent said to the woman, “You won’t surely die,

paite: Na nek ni ua pat na mit uh hongvak dia, a sia leh a pha theiin Pathian bangin na hongom ding uh chih Pathianin thie kilkel eive, a chi a.
english: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”

paite: Huchiin, numeiin, sing gah nek theih ahi chih leh, mithip tak ahi chih leh, mi pilsak dinga sing gah etlahhuai ahi chih a theihin a gah khenkhat a loua, a neta; huan, a pasal kiangah leng a pia hi, aman leng a ne teita hi.
english: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took of its fruit, and ate; and she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate.

paite: Huchiin, a nih un a mit uh a hongvaka, vuaktang ahih uh a hongkitheita ua; huchiin theipi nah a khuikhawm ua, puan a kibawl tawm uhi.
english: The eyes of both of them were opened, and they knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.

paite: Huan, Toupa Pathian, huana nitklam ni nema vak aw a ja ua; huchiin, Adam leh a jiin huana sing lakah Toupa Pathian ana kibuk santa uh.
english: They heard the voice of Yahweh God walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahweh God among the trees of the garden.

paite: Huan, Toupa Pathianin Adam a sama, a kiangah, kaw om na hia? a chi hi.
english: Yahweh God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”

paite: Huan, aman, Huana na aw ka jaa, vuaktanga om ka hih jiakin ka laua; huchiin ka buta hi, a chi hi.
english: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.”

paite: Huan, aman, vuaktang na hih kuan honhilh ahia? Sing gah nek louh hial ding ka chih ne na hita maw? A chia.
english: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”

paite: Huan, Adam in, Honompih dinga non numei piakin sing gah a hon piaa, ne kei ve, achi a.
english: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I ate.”

paite: Huai, Toupa Pathianin, numei kiangah, Na thil hih hi bangchidan ahia? A chi a. Huan, numeiin, gulin honkhema, ne kei ve, a chi hi.
english: Yahweh God said to the woman, “What is this you have done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”

paite: Huan, Toupa Pathianin, gul kiangah, hichibanga na hih jiakin gan tengteng leh gam sa chiteng lakah hamsiatin na om tuanse dinga, khupbohin na pai gige ta dia, na dam sungin leivui na nek ding ahi;
english: Yahweh God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. On your belly you shall go, and you shall eat dust all the days of your life.

paite: Huan, nang leh numei ka hon kidou sak dinga, na suante leh a suante leng ka kidou sak lai ding; huaiin na lutang a sidup sak dinga, nang a khetul na sidup sak ding, a chi a.
english: I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.”

paite: Numei kiangah, Na haksatna leh na naupaina nakpiin ka pungsak dinga; haksa takin ta na nei gige dinga; himahleh na deihlam na pasal lam ahi dinga, aman na tungah thu a nei gige ding, a chi hi.
english: To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. In pain you will bear children. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”

paite: Huan, Adam kiangah, Na ji thu na mana, sing khat, A gah na ne ding ahi kei, chia Ka hon thupiak, a gah na nek jiakin leitung nang jiakin hamsiatin a omta hi; na dam Sung tengin gim taka semin a gah na neta ding;
english: To Adam he said, “Because you have listened to your wife’s voice, and have eaten of the tree, of which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it,’ cursed is the ground for your sake. In toil you will eat of it all the days of your life.

paite: Ling leh loulingneite leng a hon omsak ding; huan, leia anteh na neta ding
english: It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field.

paite: Hun, leitunga na kiknawn masiah na maia kho-ul luang puappuapin an na neta ding; leitunga kipana lak khiak lah na hi ngala: leivui na hi a, leivui ah na kiknawn ding ahi, a chi hi.
english: By the sweat of your face will you eat bread until you return to the ground, for out of it you were taken. For you are dust, and to dust you shall return.”

paite: Huan, Adamin a ji, mi hing tengteng nu a hih jiakin, a min dingin Evi a sa hi.
english: The man called his wife Eve, because she was the mother of all living.

paite: Huan, Toupa Pathianin, Adam ading leh a ji a dingin savun puannaktualte a bawlsaka, a silhsak hi.
english: Yahweh God made coats of skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.

paite: Huan, Toupa Pathianin, Ngai un, pasal a sia leh a pha theiin ei bang a hong hita; tuin a khuta sawkin, hinna sing gah loua nein, khantawnin a hing kha ding, a chi a,
english: Yahweh God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever...”

paite: Huaijiakin, Toupa Pathianin amah a lak khiakna lei let dingin Eden huan akipan a sawlkheta hi,Huchiin pasal a delhkhetaa; huan, hinna sing lampi veng dingin Eden huan suahlam pangah Cherubimte leh mei namsau kilek jualjual a omsakta hi.
english: Therefore Yahweh God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.

paite: Huchiin pasal a delhkhetaa; huan, hinna sing lampi veng dingin Eden huan suahlam pangah Cherubimte leh mei namsau kilek jualjual a omsakta hi.
english: So he drove out the man; and he placed Cherubs at the east of the garden of Eden, and the flame of a sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.
